$comment: The capability vocabulary (platform plan 3.2): one list, used by nodes, packages, and integrations alike. A package's manifest.requires/optional and a Device's capabilities both draw from this list. Not to be confused with the robot's 20-item capability GRANT list (3.1), which is a later (Hub v0.3 / robot authorization) addition, out of spec v0.1 scope. The engine roles (vision, image, video, music, stt, tts) are named exactly as the Stack's role ids so a manifest's requires and the hub's engine allocation share one list; the chat role maps to gpu_llm or cpu_llm and the embed role to embeddings (home/docs/plans/hardware-tiers-2026-09-23.md, Capabilities follow the allocation).
